snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE - Pixel Trailer
snippet.description:
What if Final Fantasy had continued to push the limits of pixel art?
Experience a classic Final Fantasy adventure reimagined in stunning HD-2D in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE. Join Rain and his allies as they journey across exotic lands, explore dangerous dungeons and battle fearsome foes.
The first FINAL FANTASY in HD‑2D, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE is coming to Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on October 22, 2026. Pre-order is now available on all platforms.

▼Official Website
https://www.square-enix.com/asia/newsportal/en/sg/FFRS/

▼SQUARE ENIX ASIA Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/SquareEnixAsia

Platforms：Nintendo Switch™ 2／Nintendo Switch™／PlayStation®5／Xbox Series X|S／Steam®／Microsoft Store on Windows
